topic: Blackbeard's Yami Yami has a gap: a hit that lands before he absorbs it hurts; Ace and Whitebeard proved it
title: Blackbeard's Darkness Has A Flaw Whitebeard Exposed
description: Blackbeard's Yami Yami no Mi swallows attacks and cancels Devil Fruits, but Marineford showed its gap. Here's the flaw and why it matters for Shanks.
comment: Shanks vs Blackbeard: does pure Haki beat two fruits, or does Blackbeard win? Pick one.

lines.text: Blackbeard's darkness swallows everything, except one thing.

shot.search: Blackbeard Yami Yami no Mi darkness
shot.fallback: huge pirate surrounded by swirling black void

lines.text: And I think Marineford showed us exactly what it is.

shot.fallback: pirate captain on a war battlefield

lines.text: Darkness pulls attacks in, and his touch cancels any Devil Fruit, Logia, Paramecia or Zoan.

shot.fallback: hand touching glowing fruit power gone

lines.text: But the fruit only protects him if the attack goes through the darkness.

shot.fallback: man hit by attack that skips the darkness

lines.text: If he can't absorb it in time, he gets hurt like anyone else, sometimes worse.

shot.fallback: pirate struck in chest by fire

lines.text: Ace's fire spears landed in his chest.

shot.fallback: fiery spears hitting a large pirate

lines.text: Then Whitebeard drove his bisento into his shoulder at Marineford.

shot.fallback: old pirate emperor swinging a huge polearm

lines.text: And here's the detail I don't think gets enough credit.
The fruit constantly drains his body, so keeping the darkness up costs him.
The strongest counter-argument is that he took Whitebeard's Gura Gura and still stood.

shot.search: Blackbeard Gura Gura no Mi Whitebeard

lines.text: But that proves my point, because he needed a second fruit to cover the gap.
So the question for Shanks isn't whether Blackbeard can be hurt.

shot.fallback: red haired pirate facing a dark rival

lines.text: It's whether anyone can land a hit before the darkness pulls it in.
That is why Blackbeard's darkness swallows everything...

shot.search: Blackbeard Yami Yami no Mi darkness
shot.fallback: huge pirate surrounded by swirling black void
